entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The state of the Velvet Room reflects[n]the state of your own heart.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The room's changes reflect your showing[n]the spirit of rebellion to the entity that[n]binds your future.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Indeed. Your change in appearance[n]must also be due to the rebellious[n]spirit you've harbored for so long.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: And with that spirit, you appear to have[n]grasped a new possibility as well...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The current you should be capable of[n]fusing new Personas.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Please make good use of this to keep[n]the ruin at bay.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: We will continue to provide aid[n]on your perilous journey.
